name: HUD DRGR financial records
provider: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development
unit: Original award × project × activity × reporting quarter
vintage: Observed reporting quarters; national filename date is not treated as a verified extraction date.
availability: 128,382 national F31 financial rows across 206 awards, 2002Q2–2025Q1. Separate Texas Harvey F31 snapshot: 6,518 rows, 2018Q3–2026Q1. Search, filter and export exact signed financial measures.
definition: Five fields are signed quarterly net flows, not cumulative snapshots: obligations, expenditures, grant disbursements, program-income disbursements and receipts. Preserve zeros and negative adjustments.
missingness: Absent quarters are unknown. Allocation histories and verified initial execution dates require separate evidence.
linkage: Preserve original text identifiers and one source snapshot; never sum overlapping extracts.
rights: Public-document financial fields released under explicit project authorization. National financial chunks and dictionaries independently acquired from the public CECREH repository and reconciled. Upstream MIT license retained. No narratives, SimpleMaps coordinates or household data copied.

name: Texas GLO quarterly performance reports
provider: Texas General Land Office / HUD DRGR
unit: Report × activity × funding source; period and to-date columns
vintage: 2024Q4 report; source index includes later reports.
availability: Newly downloaded official Harvey 2024Q4 PDF: exact activity/grant/quarter location-scope links and selected period-dollar checks. Report status: Submitted—Await for Review.
definition: Documentary source for activity scope and explicitly labeled financial columns. A portfolio may combine original grants.
missingness: Blank award or obligation dates cannot supply verified initial execution dates. Report submission does not mean HUD approval.
linkage: Match original award, project, activity, funding source and reporting quarter. Do not allocate portfolio totals to cities.
rights: Public agency financial facts and non-household geographic references. PDFs and source narratives are linked rather than republished.

name: Census land-clipped cartographic boundaries
availability: 56 state/territory, 3,235 county/parish, 32,629 place and 36,360 county-subdivision reference polygons. Regional Albers projection. These are reference layers, not funded-activity polygons.
definition: Reference areas and representative points identify geography. They do not locate an activity or its beneficiaries.
missingness: Historical boundary equivalence is unverified. Some area types lack coordinates; they stay off the map.
linkage: Use documented government-to-area identity evidence. Headquarters counties and state context do not establish service areas.
rights: U.S. Census Bureau public government data; official ZIP hashes and transformation notes retained. No third-party city coordinates used.

name: ACS population & housing context
unit: Census geography × five-year estimate period; estimates and MOEs
availability: Seven official ACS tables; 32,330 places, including 960 financial-place identities.
definition: Population, income, poverty and housing estimates describe community context; five-year estimates are not independent quarterly measurements.
missingness: Direct estimates and 90% MOEs are included; source suppression/special codes are preserved. Five-year window is not a historical quarterly observation.
linkage: Direct seven-digit state+place GEOID; estimates, 90% MOEs and special missing codes retained.
rights: Official Census federal statistical data, acquired as no-key summary files; exact source receipts retained.

name: Flood hazard & hydrologic context
unit: Flood-zone polygon, raster or documented exposure aggregate
availability: FEMA NFHL city intersections; explicit mapped coverage and SFHA, no individual locations.
definition: Mapped flood hazard, observed flood loss and hydrologic exposure are different constructs.
missingness: Mapped fraction and undetermined area are explicit. Unmapped city areas are unknown, not zero hazard. Only financially linked place identities are processed.
linkage: Unsimplified Census 2024 city boundary; local equal-area union/intersection. Full boundary includes water.
checked: 2026-10-27: official public NFHL archive and metadata verified
rights: Public federal NFHL facts; source edition, metadata and exact derivation retained. Regulatory map context is not an individual-property determination.

name: Land cover & land-use evidence
unit: Raster cell or documented municipal land-area share
availability: NLCD land cover and separate USDA LCMS modeled land-use summaries; neither is zoning.
definition: Land cover measures observed surface classes. It is not a zoning or land-use regulation measure.
missingness: Only financially linked place identities are processed; CONUS raster products leave other regions unavailable. Land cover and modeled use do not establish zoning.
linkage: 30 m pixel-center zonal summaries on unsimplified 2024 Census place polygons. No display geometry used.
rights: USGS metadata use constraints: None. USDA public-funded LCMS is available without additional fees/permissions; source attribution and model limitations retained.

name: Government identity & resources
provider: U.S. Census Bureau / BLS / local governments
unit: Government unit; fiscal year; employment period
vintage: 2024 survey; item-year, MMDD year-end and imputation flags retained
availability: Census 2024 municipal finance E23/E29/E50; 3,843 places, including 279 financial-place links.
definition: Government existence is separate from fiscal resources, staffing, NGO capacity and administrative performance.
missingness: Finance is a sample; absent municipality/items are missing, not zero. Inputs were reviewed for aggregate estimates, not accurate individual-unit time series. Staffing and district service areas remain unavailable.
linkage: Exact government ID and official FIPS place, municipality type 2 only. Sample inputs, not reviewed individual-unit time series or staffing.
rights: Official Census public statistical facts and unit identifiers; required sample and quality cautions included. No headquarters addresses published.

name: Building Permits Survey
unit: Place × calendar year; housing units and valuation
vintage: Calendar year and release-specific; verify reporting-month coverage
availability: No permit records are included; official source reference is available.
definition: Permitting describes housing supply activity. It is not staffing, land-use composition or recovery effectiveness.
missingness: Incomplete reporting months and unresolved source footnotes must remain visible.
linkage: Join exact place GEOID and year; never fill earlier periods with later-year context.
rights: No permit records bundled; review source definitions and release conditions.

name: HUD initial grant dates and historical public QPRs
availability: 29 national panel awards with verified initial execution; 193 separate candidate effective dates. 59 exact-period QPRs across 27 awards, with original review status.
unit: Original grant and activity; nominal USD cents
vintage: Initial dates corroborated in 2019 and 2023 summaries; each QPR retains period and publication date
definition: Initial execution clock; same-scope cumulative To Date E/O and allocated activity-budget ratios; whole-grant allocation only where separately verified.
missingness: Unknown initial dates and historic whole-grant allocations stay null. Unapproved QPRs retain evidence but no eligible ratios.
linkage: Exact original grant IDs; original activity/project keys where verified.
rights: Official public HUD financial reports; no household narratives or addresses republished.
provider: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development

name: Census ASPEP March 2025 municipal benchmark
unit: Government × March benchmark × function; persons and nominal USD payroll
vintage: March 2025; exact PID join to 2024 directory
availability: 2,855 municipal places; 230 financial-place links; 9,470 function rows
definition: Full-time and part-time employment and payroll, total and selected administrative/housing functions. Not CDBG staffing or a time series.
missingness: Annual sample; missing is not zero. Reported and imputation flags retained.
linkage: Exact government PID6 with active municipal type and official FIPS state agreement; direct place GEOID
rights: Public federal statistical facts; Census individual-unit cautions retained

name: Official municipal archives and HUD recipient indexes
unit: Source link and independently verified grant/period where available
status: Inventory with explicit unchecked and failed states
availability: 1023 entries for 40 municipal awards; 19 of 21 index pages retrieved
definition: Source-by-source review status, original files, exact horizon verification; offline transformer retrieval supplements deterministic checks
missingness: Most linked amendment bodies and non-horizon reports unreviewed; not exhaustive. HTTP403/TLS failures retained.
linkage: HUD exact grant metadata; city link remains unverified until PDF checked
rights: Public index links and non-sensitive financial facts only

name: Census 2026 government listing and exact-ID/transformer audit
unit: Government/dependent system PID6, separate from geographic boundaries
vintage: FY ending June 30, 2026; extracted August 13; released September 24
availability: 91,729 independent governments; 1,323 dependent schools; 4,338 pensions. Historical 2022 retained separately.
definition: All observed financial name/state queries receive offline transformer candidate retrieval plus exact-PID verification; candidates do not create funding/geography links.
missingness: 50 states and DC; tribal and territorial government universes excluded. 54 financial entities lack geographic reference.
linkage: All 1,494 existing GOV2022 financial entity IDs found in 2026; 3,283 name/state queries reviewed by model, no automatic new joins.
rights: Public federal directory facts; all contact/address fields omitted
